entities.name: Park Hon-young

entities.summary: Pak Hon-yong, courtesy name Togyong (덕영), was a Korean independence activist, politician, philosopher, communist activist and one of the main leaders of the Korean communist movement during Japan's colonial rule (1910–1945).
